content: Supabase Management API: POST https://api.supabase.com/v1/projects/{ref}/database/query with Authorization: Bearer <SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN>. Body accepts query (string, required), parameters (array, optional), and read_only (boolean, optional). Setting read_only true executes in read-only mode and prevents any database modification. Returns 201 on success; 401/403/429/500 error codes. Requires database:write OAuth scope or a fine-grained token with database_read.
